Local LLM VRAM & KV-Cache Scaling (8K vs. 32K vs. 128K Context)

Many local LLM guides only measure model weights at 2K–4K context. Once you push context to 32K or 128K tokens, KV-cache memory grows significantly—for example, a 70B Q4 model jumps from 45.5 GB (8K) to 71.8 GB (128K). Check your own hardware using the interactive VRAM & Electricity Calculator.
